title: Points Earning Rate Card for Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Tiers
content:
Base earn rate, per-transaction maximum and balance rules for **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** points, by tier.

| Tier | Base points per qualifying dollar (before any program multiplier) | Fractional points per earning transaction | Most points one earning transaction may post | Whole balance expires after this many calendar days without any points earning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | 8 | rounded down | 5,000 (5000) | 365 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | 10 | rounded down | 7,500 (7500) | 365 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | 12 | rounded down | 10,000 (10000) | 365 |
| Tailwise Plus Monthly | 12 | rounded down | 10,000 (10000) | 0 (no expiry while the tier is held) |
| Tailwise Plus Annual | 12 | rounded down | 10,000 (10000) | 0 (no expiry while the tier is held) |
| Tailwise Plus Premier Annual | 15 | rounded down | 15,000 (15000) | 0 (no expiry while the tier is held) |

## Settings common to every tier

| Setting | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Purchases that never earn points | gift cards, donations, membership fees |
| Membership fees earn points | No |
| Points earned on a refunded purchase are taken back | Yes |
| A reversal may take the balance below zero | No |

## Notes

- An expiry figure of 0 means points never expire while that tier is held.
- The base earn rate is stated before any program multiplier.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** At the Pals Rewards Insider base rate of 10 points per qualifying dollar, $23.45 of qualifying spend comes to 234.5 points before rounding, which rounds down to 234.
